summary: Acer 16 Predator Neo features Intel Core i9-12900H processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti graphics card, 32GB DDR5 RAM, and 1TB NVMe SSD. The laptop has a liquid metal cooling system on the CPU and may experience thermal throttling due to high-performance components.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling: Possible due to high-performance components and limited cooling system.
suggested_solution: Monitor system temperatures, adjust usage accordingly, and regularly update drivers and BIOS to prevent overheating.
